_comment: Tier-2: inlet imposes a VELOCITY vector and outlet imposes PRESSURE = 0; reversing them over-determines pressure. Pitfall (kratos.fluid #3). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Both variables resolve on core and on neither FluidDynamicsApplication, and both spellings are equally valid Kratos variables — nothing rejects the reversed assignment, which is exactly why the claim's failure is a wrong mass flux rather than an exception. The fixture pins the variable surface a boundary-condition process has to name. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
